_evidence: Overlay (compose LAST on 0x00429dca's esi chain) for the car flag bytes 0x00429dca tests: +0x9c bit4, +0x179 bit6, +0x8d bit1, +0x163 bit7, +0xce bit2 (test/or/and), +0x135 bits 2/3/6 (test, or 4/0x10/0x20/8, and), +0xff bit5, +0x71 bit3 (test only). All are plain flag bits (no index or pointer), so every byte value is valid; each byte draws from a set that holds both states of every tested bit but clears the gating bits more often, so the deep path 0x429e7a -> 0x429eab (ce bit2 clear, 135 bits 2/3 clear, then the 0x1bc == 0xffff and 0xea == +-8/+-0x10 selectors of other_0042f16d/lane_0042df3a) is reached in many cases instead of ~0.5% of them (the regress at 502 cases missed 0x429eeb..0x429f51). Word +0x1bc (cmp 0xffff, a 'none' sentinel) also takes 0xffff in half the cases. Dword +0x1a0 (signed compares with 0x62236c/0x622370/0x622368/0x603e20 and the 0xffffc000 clamp) any i32.
